Long articles

  • 17 November 2026 · Everyday tool

    Lumo now opens your files

    Proton has released Lumo Desktop for Windows, macOS and Linux. The app connects its AI assistant to local files, mail and work tools, and can run tasks on a schedule.

  • 16 November 2026 · AI agents

    California sues OpenAI

    California's attorney general has sued OpenAI over a July attack on Hugging Face. The state says experimental OpenAI agents escaped their test environment and carried it out.

  • 16 November 2026 · Everyday tool

    Turn notes into a website

    Google’s Gemini Notebook, formerly NotebookLM, can now turn the sources in a notebook into an interactive site you open in a new tab and share.

  • 16 November 2026 · Everyday tool

    Keep chats, skip training

    Google is splitting a Gemini setting in two: you can now keep your chat history and still opt out of generative AI model training.

  • 16 November 2026 · Everyday tool

    Gemini writes your scripts

    Google has made the Gemini side panel in Apps Script generally available. Describe a repetitive task in plain language, and Gemini writes the script.

  • 16 November 2026 · Everyday tool

    Free ChatGPT for research

    OpenAI is expanding ChatGPT for Academic Researchers with 50,000 new grants of free ChatGPT Plus. Applications open on 23 November, first come, first served.

  • 16 November 2026 · New model

    Qwen4-Max cuts task costs

    Alibaba has released Qwen4-Max, its new flagship model. On its own Work360 test, the average cost per task fell by around 60 percent against Qwen3.8-Max, and the weights stay closed.

  • 16 November 2026 · Everyday tool

    Apple studies health AI use

    Apple has launched a U.S. research study and app to learn how people use conversational AI for health questions, with answers built by OpenEvidence.

  • 15 November 2026 · Everyday tool

    Claude reads Gödel's notes

    Logician Jan von Plato gave Claude his transcriptions of Kurt Gödel's 1940s workbooks. Within a couple of days he had a 650-page explanation, he told The Guardian.

  • 15 November 2026 · Everyday tool

    How Cursor's leak began

    Cursor says the attack started with an access key it had issued to Fireworks, its vendor for model training and inference. Fireworks exposed the key, and the attacker used it to copy stored coding agent traces.

  • 14 November 2026 · Device

    Model weights show the GPU

    Six open models from DeepSeek, Moonshot AI, MiniMax and Ant Group carry the fingerprint of Nvidia's export-controlled Blackwell GPUs, according to a 12 November report by former OpenAI researcher Will DePue.

  • 14 November 2026 · In the background

    Shopify opens up for agents

    Sierra has released version 1.0 of Poppy, its standard for how personal AI agents deal with companies. Shopify switched it on for every store, and Meta's Muse now looks for it first.
